title.zh: 将南达沃省 萨兰加尼市镇 Sangkok Datal 中学的名称变更为Jose De Arce 纪念中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Sangkok Datal High School in the Municipality of Sarangani, Province of Davao Del Sur, to Jose De Arce Memorial High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Sangkok Datal High School in the Municipality of Sarangani, Province of Davao Del Sur, to Jose De Arce Memorial High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông Sangkok Datal tại Thị trấn Sarangani, Tỉnh Davao Del Sur thành Trường trung học phổ thông Jose De Arce Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Sangkok Datal ในเทศบาล Sarangani, จังหวัด Davao Del Sur เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Jose De Arce Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Sangkok Datal di Kotamadya Sarangani, Provinsi Davao Del Sur menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Jose De Arce Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Sangkok Datal di Perbandaran Sarangani, Wilayah Davao Del Sur menjadi Sekolah Menengah Jose De Arce Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1996/ra_8207_1996.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Sangkok Datal High School in the Municipality of Sarangani, Province of Davao del Sur, is hereby changed to Jose de Arce Memorial High School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
